title: BioLab Theme D — complete understanding-level teaching-depth and syllabus-source ledger
method: Recount exact Learn explanation words in a verified starting commit and the current branch, match all 171 numbered IDs to the repository's prior official IB Guide/Hodder source-location matrix, verify HL/shared split and direct Learn text provenance, and screen selected high-risk concepts. The Guide's complete Theme D numbering was independently read from PDF pp.92–113; this output paraphrases rather than reproduces its protected statements.
limitations: 150 main-teaching words is a minimum-depth screen, not proof of teaching completeness.
Hodder page pointers are from the existing editorial source crosswalk; they are not a newly certified sentence-level content match.
Every syllabus nuance and worked example still requires qualified examiner or subject-specialist review.
New visual-lab assets and assessment-team review are separate from this editorial branch.
